modalities.clinical_role: Resting 12-lead ECG. First-line test for suspected myocardial infarction and the only modality here that is universally available at the point of care.
modalities.data_requirement: PTB-XL WFDB records plus ptbxl_database.csv and scp_statements.csv
modalities.notes: Measured: balanced accuracy 0.8620, AUROC 0.9374. Reads a state already present; it is not an early warning.
modalities.reason: loader registered and data source present

modalities.clinical_role: Structured clinical record: demographics, NYHA class, vitals, laboratory biomarkers (Pro-BNP, troponin, creatinine), echocardiographic measurements, chest-radiograph indices, ECG intervals, Holter/HRV summaries and medications.
modalities.data_requirement: A profile JSON whose cohort declares a horizon and index/outcome times
modalities.notes: Measured: AUROC 0.768 for cardiac death within 4 years. The only genuinely prognostic channel in this frame.
modalities.reason: loader registered and data source present

modalities.clinical_role: X-ray coronary angiography. The clinical reference standard for coronary stenosis; a lesion's calibre is read directly from the contrast-filled tree.
modalities.data_requirement: A directory of angiography frames plus a labels CSV (frame,label)
modalities.notes: Extractor implemented and unit-tested (multi-scale Hessian vesselness); no frames on disk, so this modality has never produced a number. CADICA is openly downloadable and matches this loader's expectations.
modalities.reason: no data source configured for this modality

modalities.clinical_role: Genomic risk. A published coronary-artery-disease polygenic score, which is fixed at birth and therefore contributes risk context no measurement can date.
modalities.data_requirement: A PGS Catalog scoring file, a per-sample genotype dosage table, and outcomes
modalities.notes: The model is published and openly downloadable (PGS000018 metaGRS_CAD, 1,745,180 variants) so nothing is fitted; individual-level genotypes are what this platform lacks. One feature per patient, so a quantum feature map has nothing to entangle -- marked not quantum-capable deliberately.
modalities.reason: no data source configured for this modality

modalities.clinical_role: Transthoracic echocardiography. Source of LVEF, the single strongest prognostic measurement in heart failure, plus chamber and valve assessment.
modalities.data_requirement: Echo video volumes; no loader implemented in this repo
modalities.notes: Declared, not implemented. EchoNet-Dynamic publishes both data and pretrained weights (LVEF mean absolute error 4.1%), so this is the cheapest imaging modality to add next; MUSIC already carries LVEF as a tabular feature.
modalities.reason: no loader registered; this modality is declared but not implemented

readiness.note: A modality reported 'needs_data' is code-complete and starved, not broken. 'stub' means declared but unimplemented.

fusion.rule: skill-weighted mean of threshold-aligned calibrated probabilities
fusion.weight_source: each modality's own validation balanced accuracy
fusion.limitation: The cardiovascular cohorts here are disjoint, so a fused score pools independent evidence but its improvement over the best single modality is not measurable on this data.
